text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I lived a life with zero regrets." 
...That's the kind of life I wanna lead, 
ya know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, those are nice words and all, but I 
kinda can't focus on that right now——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did ya say, punk?! You refusing 
to Memento Mori right now, huh, punk?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because... what are we gonna do~?! We 
actually went and found real treasure!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch, the true identity of the treasure is 
just plain gold? Don't want it, don't need 
it, trash like this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! Why not?! It's overflowing with 
gold coins, it looks totally like real 
treasure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship loading actual gold onto a ship 
to take home? That's boring as hell. I'd 
be laughed at for generations!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: THAT's your issue with it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(Rustle rustle!!)*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that, did a bear show up?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Creature
text_block_list.text:
——Iaaa da'ggon aahhh!! 
——Rwarrululuuuiyeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, just a bear.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bears don't have fish fins!! That is 
definitely a monster guarding the 
treasure!! To think there'd be one on this 
island too...!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Creature
text_block_list.text: ——Fhngluiiiii... ——Fhtagn K'tuluuuu...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
From the front too! Now we're completely 
boxed in...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now things are gettin' fun! Kita-chan, you 
head back with Trainer first!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! What in the world are you 
thinking——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Mr. Bear! I'm gonna fillet ya 
into three neat cuts!

text_block_list.name: Bear?
text_block_list.text:
——SACRIFICE... ESCAPED... CAPTURE... 
OFFER...! ——Iaaa Hydr'aaa Dagonnn...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Golshi-san! Could it be, you're using 
yourself as decoy...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I lived a life with zero regrets." 
...That's the kind of life I wanna lead, 
ya know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to go save her...! But against this 
many monsters, by myself... I can't...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
............Guh! Please stay safe! I'm 
bringing help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, I was accompanying their second 
treasure hunt. After the terrible ordeal 
previously, I couldn't simply let students 
go off to a deserted island alone.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Trainer-san! Call the 
police and the Self-Defense Forces right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san is being attacked by monsters! 
To let me escape, she sacrificed herself 
and...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's this about Golshi-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but... you were cornered by those 
monsters——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
——I won. Lured 'em onto the suspension 
bridge and snipped the ropes all in one 
go, boom.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
THANK GOODNESSSSS! For a second I didn't 
know what was going to happen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's blow this joint of a lame island and 
go grab some shark burgers on our way 
back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I found that pile of gold coins 
earlier. What do we do with 'em? I don't 
want 'em myself though.
choice_data_list:
Does a pile of gold coins really even 
exist...?

Does a pile of gold coins really even

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I found that pile of gold coins 
earlier. What do we do with 'em? I don't 
want 'em myself though.

exist...?

Does a pile of gold coins really even

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pretty classy, ain'tcha? As long as 
there's treasure, this place stays a 
Treasure Island.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, set sail for the Seven 
Seas!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was genuinely worried, you know! 
Especially when you went on about "every 
day is a last run" and all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Did I say that? Well, that kind of 
lifestyle is pretty romantic. But that 
ain't me, chief. After all——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My last run is gonna be decided by ME, 
myself and I!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geesh, adults who've forgotten dreams and 
romance are so uncool. Well, whatever, it 
looked like cursed money anyway.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please take this as a lesson and don't go 
on dangerous adventures anymore! Next 
time, I'm definitely stopping you!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gol-chan is gonna cry from Kita-chan's 
pure kindness. Buuuut, impossible things 
are impossible. 'Cause y'know——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This world is a racetrack with NO GATES! 
Like hell I can stop just 'cause someone 
yells stop!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welp, let's donate the whole stash to the 
World's Biggest Takoyaki Association. 
Let's show everyone who this Earth really 
belongs to!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Creature
text_block_list.text: ——K'tulu...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eek, it followed us?! RUN! If we get 
caught, it really WILL be our last run!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh, like hell I'm gonna let 'em catch me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I'm the one who decides when my own 
last run is!!
